title: The range: DoD testing playground in the California desert

tellings.quote: Uh the range was a giant playground for Department of Defense and its private aerospace partners for testing weapons technology,

plain: A testing range in the California desert was, around 2001, "a giant playground" where the Department of Defense and private aerospace companies tested weapons technology. A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he worked there and later helped recover a UFO, describes it to Michels from his own time on the range.
